output.summary: A biennial herb native to Europe and Asia, chicory usually has vivid blue flowers, though they are rarely white or pink. Cultivated varieties provide salad leaves, tender shoots and roots; the roots may be cooked or roasted and ground as a coffee substitute.
output.edibilityNote: Leaves and tender shoots are eaten in salads; cultivated roots are cooked or roasted and ground as a coffee substitute or food additive.
